cases.oracle: payload.c remove: reads the txn= record, runs the image helper rollback once, prints 'payload: removed NAME' (payload.c:783); a completed rollback leaves no state record. Expected text is the literal message in the source.
cases.comparison: r2: after a real install, 'payload remove tiny' rolls the txn back with the default image helper, prints the removal message and leaves no state files; no network or host path is used. The real /bash-os/bl-pkg.sh belongs to the bashy.box image and is absent from the frozen payload and the guest image, and the staged archive is a placeholder because its format is defined by that helper; the candidate therefore stops at the missing-installer check (status 127) and the installed state never appears.
